summary: Fixed SaaS settings cache invalidation bug where cache.delete wiped the host's default cache instead of the specific tenant cache.
commit_subject: fix(tenancy): pass explicit tenantId to invalidateAppSettings
commit_body:
saveDefaults and other settings savers run `invalidateAppSettings()` after the ambient context from `withRequestTenant` is already closed, which caused it to fall back to `currentTenant()` (the default tenant) and wrongly wipe the host's cache instead of the SaaS tenant's.

Modified `invalidateAppSettings` to accept an explicit `tenantId`, and updated all `actions.ts` callers to pass `(await softRequestTenant()).tenantId`.
tests_added: Modified apps/web/src/app/settings/actions.tenant.test.ts to add a test proving saveDefaults invalidates the correct tenant cache.
notes_for_reviewer: The fix was applied uniformly across all 14 callers of `invalidateAppSettings` in `actions.ts`. The implementation of `invalidateAppSettings` was updated to handle `explicitTenantId` properly.
